meta.outlay_rule: Step 1: EUROMOD J2.0+ <ExternalStatistic> amount for the country's main minimum-income instrument (the scheme the SPC 2025 MI Report names), latest year up to 2024. Uprated to 2024 on the GDP deflator (RULES.md G3).
